unit.why: A cited passage from a preface to Psalms on studying the Zohar, with the Besht's custom urging daily study of Tikkunei Zohar mentioned only as a practice and no narrated event; it ends with the heading of the next section ('מענין ליצנות').
unit.boundary_note: Closing words 'מענין ליצנות' are a section heading belonging to the next division.
